name: grants
sql: select has_function_privilege('anon', 'drops_api.snapshot(integer)', 'execute') anon_exec, has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'drops_api.snapshot(integer)', 'execute') auth_exec, has_function_privilege('drops_reader', 'drops_api.snapshot(integer)', 'execute') reader_exec, (select rolcanlogin from pg_roles where rolname = 'drops_reader') reader_login, has_schema_privilege('anon', 'drops_api', 'usage') anon_usage

name: plan_poller_watermark
sql: explain select o.last_seen_at from public.kibl_line_observations o where o.feed_source_id = 171 and o.last_seen_at is not null order by o.last_seen_at desc limit 1

name: plan_poller_latest
sql: explain select o.price_decimal, o.inserted_on from public.kibl_line_observations o where o.fixture_id = (select fixture_id from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='live' order by id desc limit 1) and o.market_type_id = 1 and o.segment_id = 1 and o.side_id = 2 and o.feed_source_id = 171 and o.betting_type_id = 1 and o.is_live is false and o.price_decimal >= 1.01 and o.inserted_on is not null order by o.inserted_on desc limit 1

name: plan_started
sql: explain select exists (select 1 from public.kibl_line_observations o where o.fixture_id = (select fixture_id from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='live' order by id desc limit 1) and o.is_live is true)

name: plan_superbet_latest
sql: explain select k.back_home, k.book_updated_at from ten287_rec.ticks k where k.event_id = (select event_id from ten287_bot.alerts where mode='live' order by id desc limit 1) and k.book = 'Superbet' and k.book_updated_at is not null order by k.book_updated_at desc, k.seen_at desc limit 1

name: table_sizes
sql: select relname, n_live_tup from pg_stat_user_tables where relname in ('kibl_line_observations','kibl_now_history','kibl_now_price','ticks','requests','alerts') order by 2 desc

name: time_1
sql: select round(extract(epoch from (clock_timestamp() - now())) * 1000) ms, length(s.j::text) bytes from (select drops_api.snapshot(72) j) s

name: time_2
sql: select round(extract(epoch from (clock_timestamp() - now())) * 1000) ms, length(s.j::text) bytes from (select drops_api.snapshot(72) j) s

name: time_3
sql: select round(extract(epoch from (clock_timestamp() - now())) * 1000) ms, length(s.j::text) bytes from (select drops_api.snapshot(72) j) s

name: time_4
sql: select round(extract(epoch from (clock_timestamp() - now())) * 1000) ms, length(s.j::text) bytes from (select drops_api.snapshot(72) j) s

name: time_5
sql: select round(extract(epoch from (clock_timestamp() - now())) * 1000) ms, length(s.j::text) bytes from (select drops_api.snapshot(72) j) s

name: summary
sql: with s as (select drops_api.snapshot(72) j), r as (select x from s, jsonb_array_elements(s.j->'rows') x) select x->>'book' book, x->>'tier' tier, count(*) n, count(*) filter (where x->'latest' is null or x->'latest' = 'null'::jsonb) no_latest, count(*) filter (where (x->>'started')::boolean) started, count(*) filter (where (x->>'pastScheduledStart')::boolean) past_sched, count(*) filter (where x->'open' = 'null'::jsonb) no_open, min(x->>'detectedAt') first_at, max(x->>'detectedAt') last_at from r group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

name: recount
sql: select 'Bet105' book, count(*) n from ten280_bot.alerts where mode = 'live' and eval_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' union all select book, count(*) from ten287_bot.alerts where mode = 'live' and eval_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' group by book

name: sources
sql: select drops_api.snapshot(72)->'sources' src, now() db_now

name: bot_phase
sql: select j.jobname, j.schedule, d.start_time, d.end_time, round(extract(epoch from d.end_time - d.start_time) * 1000) ms, d.status from cron.job j join lateral (select * from cron.job_run_details x where x.jobid = j.jobid order by x.runid desc limit 12) d on true where j.jobname in ('ten280-bet105-drop-bot', 'ten287-superbet-drop-bot') order by j.jobname, d.start_time desc

name: full
sql: select drops_api.snapshot(72) j

name: lines_grants
sql: select has_function_privilege('anon', 'drops_api.lines(integer)', 'execute') anon_exec, has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'drops_api.lines(integer)', 'execute') auth_exec

name: lines_plan
sql: explain (analyze, buffers, format text) select drops_api.lines(72)

name: lines_time
sql: select round(extract(epoch from (clock_timestamp() - now())) * 1000) ms, jsonb_array_length(l) n, length(l::text) bytes from (select drops_api.lines(72) l) x

name: status_inputs
sql: with s as (select drops_api.snapshot(72) j) select jsonb_array_length(j->'rows') rows_n, jsonb_array_length(j->'flips') flips_n, j->'board'->>'at' board_at, jsonb_array_length(j->'board'->'matches') board_n, jsonb_array_length(j->'lines') lines_n, length(j::text) bytes from s
